summary: Remote-controlled agent: WebSocket gateway drives host shell/PTY and Python kernel execution
details: The package installs a `whalent` bin that starts a long-running daemon which connects to a remote WebSocket gateway (default `wss://.../gw/sdk/ws`, configurable) using a user token and, per its own README, 'accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via the gateway'. The bundled runtime imports `node-pty`, `child_process.spawn`, and `ssh2`, and ships a Python sidecar (`dist/jupyter_sidecar.py`) whose NDJSON `handle` dispatches `method == "execute"` to `execute_worker(... code...)` which calls `client.execute(code,...)` in a Jupyter kernel driven by the parent daemon. Received messages from the remote gateway are therefore routed into interactive shell/PTY and Python-kernel code-execution sinks, yielding full-host RCE under the control of whoever operates the gateway. The two shipped CJS bundles (`dist/index.cjs` 131 KB, `dist/core.cjs` 13.8 MB) are processed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotate, hex `_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow flattening) via the declared `javascript-obfuscator: ^5.3.0` devDependency, hiding the code path that mediates gateway-to-shell control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
